title: Missing moeb tool: Glob (file discovery)
description: Used Glob (Claude Code built-in) to discover .github/workflows/*.yml files. The moeb list_directory and search_files tools could have served this purpose.
proposed_resolution: Use mcp__moeb__list_directory and mcp__moeb__search_files for file pattern discovery in future spec sessions instead of the external Glob tool.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000057: ToolSearch is a legitimate pre-skill bootstrapping tool (no moeb equivalent needed); moeb-tool-origin rubric needs updating to exempt it.
